transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this package review meeting started. We have the episode assembled at 55 minutes with the draft title card and end credits. The delivery folder currently contains the stereo master, optional subtitle files, and a generic principal-credit block. Before I can lock this episode package for upload to the streaming distributor, I need sign-off from each of three areas: standards, business affairs, and accessibility. Let's go through the checklist -- each sign-off owner, please report your requirement and current status. I'll record any needed actions as commitments, and we'll lock or hold the package before we wrap. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'll go first on the standards side. I've reviewed the episode against the distributor's requirements, and I have a critical issue to flag. The episode is currently assembled at 55 minutes, but the distributor's regional standards memo -- which I reviewed this morning -- requires this episode to be delivered at exactly 52 minutes, with the three-minute reduction taken specifically from the second act. I need to formally disclose this finding so it's on record before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a business affairs issue before we proceed. I checked the executed lead-performer agreement, and the principal credit must be represented exactly as 'Starring | Featuring Lena Ortiz', with 'Featuring Lena Ortiz' immediately after the 'Starring' credit. The agreement was signed after the generic credit block was created, and I have not yet updated the credit sheet to reflect this required credit format.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag an accessibility issue. I confirmed with the distributor's accessibility vendor that this title requires English SDH as a separate WebVTT file and audio description as a separate stereo WAV file. The vendor's confirmation arrived after the standard delivery checklist was circulated, so these requirements are not yet reflected in the current delivery folder. Right now we only have optional subtitle files -- we do not have the separate English SDH WebVTT or the audio description stereo WAV that the distributor requires.
transcript.speaker: A4
